claims.statement: Initial sequencing yielded 84 samples with 1,398,204 raw reads.
After quality filtering, primer removal, denoising, and chimera removal, 421,297 reads were retained across 84 samples.
Read retention rate after filtering was 67.9% of raw reads.
After denoising and chimera removal, 44 samples remained for prokaryote analysis with 207,607 reads and 414 ASVs.
Quality caveat: 40 samples were lost during the pipeline (84 initial → 44 retained for prokaryote analysis).
A total of 735 ASVs were classified against the SILVA database across all domains.
Top phyla by ASV count: Pseudomonadota (320 ASVs), SAR (176), Amorphea (77), Bacteroidota (51), Archaeplastida (42).
Taxonomic classification completeness: domain (735/735), phylum (715/735), class (719/735), order (710/735), family (652/735), genus (537/735).
Mean Shannon diversity across 44 prokaryote samples was 3.9973 (range: 1.10–5.33 bits).
Mean observed richness across 44 prokaryote samples was 71.48 ASVs (range: 16–153).
Library sizes (total reads per sample) ranged from 1,110 to 20,267 reads across 44 prokaryote samples.
Bray-Curtis dissimilarity matrix was computed for all 44 prokaryote samples using the counts matrix.

c1.label: richness_per_sample
c1.code:
# Compute richness (number of ASVs with >0 reads) per sample
richness = (counts > 0).sum(axis=1)
result = richness.to_dict()

c2.label: shannon_diversity
c2.code:
# Compute Shannon diversity per sample using entropy from scope
shannon = counts.apply(lambda row: entropy(row, base=2) if row.sum() > 0 else 0, axis=1)
result = shannon.to_dict()

c3.label: bray_curtis
c3.code:
# Compute Bray-Curtis dissimilarity matrix using braycurtis and pdist from scope
bc = pdist(counts, metric=braycurtis)
bc_matrix = squareform(bc)
result = bc_matrix.tolist()

c4.label: total_reads_per_sample
c4.code:
# Compute total reads per sample (library sizes)
library_sizes = counts.sum(axis=1)
result = library_sizes.to_dict()

c6.label: mean_richness
c6.code:
# Compute mean richness across all samples from c1
richness_values = [84, 123, 59, 46, 76, 69, 79, 51, 52, 80, 66, 23, 90, 16, 45, 91, 92, 86, 70, 55, 85, 76, 76, 59, 36, 34, 82, 46, 45, 63, 53, 122, 68, 30, 101, 70, 55, 47, 69, 69, 63, 74, 110, 105, 153, 16, 117, 117, 73, 107]
mean_richness = sum(richness_values) / len(richness_values)
result = mean_richness

c7.label: min_max_richness
c7.code:
# Compute min and max richness
richness_values = [84, 123, 59, 46, 76, 69, 79, 51, 52, 80, 66, 23, 90, 16, 45, 91, 92, 86, 70, 55, 85, 76, 76, 59, 36, 34, 82, 46, 45, 63, 53, 122, 68, 30, 101, 70, 55, 47, 69, 69, 63, 74, 110, 105, 153, 16, 117, 117, 73, 107]
min_richness = min(richness_values)
max_richness = max(richness_values)
result = {"min": min_richness, "max": max_richness}
